body_markdown:
The holiday season is all about gratitude. And in multifamily and commercial real estate, there's a whole crew of people who earn it every single day.


They're the ones answering the 2 a.m. leak call and keeping the lawns green and the walkways clear. They turn a first tour into a signed lease, and somehow, they keep the budget, the owners, and the residents happy all at once.


So, we asked our LinkedIn community a simple question:


***Which on-site role deserves the biggest thank-you this year?*** You showed up with your votes, and the results were pretty clear.


Not exactly a nail-biter! But every role on this list keeps a property running, and every one of them deserves a moment in the spotlight.


##


**Maintenance Techs: The Landslide Winners**


Honestly? We're not surprised.


Maintenance techs are the people residents call when something goes wrong, and something always goes wrong. A furnace quits on the first cold night of the year. A dishwasher floods a kitchen the day before a family dinner. A make-ready has to be perfect by Friday because a new resident is moving in on Saturday.


They fix it, they clean up after themselves, and they're usually off to the next work order before anyone thinks to say thank you. They're problem-solvers, plumbers, electricians, and HVAC whisperers rolled into one. Resident satisfaction lives and dies on their work, and renewals follow right behind.


So to every maintenance tech out there: 64% of our community sees you. Thank you for everything you keep running.


##


**Gratitude For the Rest of the Crew**


**Groundskeepers (18%):** First impressions start at the curb. Groundskeepers make sure a property looks cared for before anyone steps in the door, through summer heat, falling leaves, and the first snow. Curb appeal sells units and keeps tenants proud of where they live and work. That's no small thing.


**Property managers (14%):** Property managers are the air traffic controllers of the site. They juggle owner goals, resident needs, budgets, vendors, and their own teams, often in the same hour. When a property runs smoothly, there's usually a great manager behind the curtain making it look easy.


**Leasing pros (4%):** Okay, leasing pros, the vote count was small, but your impact isn't. You're the first face a future resident meets and the reason a tour becomes a home. Occupancy, revenue, and a property's reputation all start with you. Consider this your extra helping of well-deserved thanks.


##


**Pass the Gratitude Along**


Here's the thing about on-site teams: no single role carries a property alone. The tech fixes the leak, the groundskeeper keeps the entrance sharp, the leasing pro fills the unit, and the property manager holds it all together. It takes the whole crew.


At BG Staffing, we're proud to connect these on-site heroes with multifamily and commercial properties, and we're grateful for every one of them! So, thank a teammate today and share your gratitude throughout the year.
